title: Warrior Class
content: Warriors are melee fighters who run on rage, built by dealing and taking damage, and switch between Battle, Defensive and Berserker stances. Their trees are Arms and Fury for damage and Protection for tanking. They wear mail until level 40 and plate after, and every race except blood elves can be one.

title: Paladin Class
content: Paladins are plate-wearing holy warriors who run on mana: Holy heals, Protection tanks and Retribution deals melee damage. They buff the group with blessings and auras, use seals and judgements in combat, and carry Divine Shield. Humans, dwarves, draenei and blood elves can be paladins.

title: Hunter Class
content: Hunters fight at range with bows, guns or crossbows, which still use arrows or bullets in Wrath, and keep a tamed beast as a pet. They run on mana, wear mail from level 40, and use traps, aspects and Feign Death. Their trees are Beast Mastery, Marksmanship and Survival.

title: Rogue Class
content: Rogues are leather-wearing melee fighters who run on energy and build combo points to spend on finishers like Eviscerate. They can stealth, sap, pick locks and apply poisons bought from poison vendors. Their trees are Assassination, Combat and Subtlety.

title: Priest Class
content: Priests wear cloth and run on mana: Discipline and Holy heal and Shadow deals damage from Shadowform. Their utility includes Power Word: Fortitude, Fear Ward, Mind Control and resurrection. Humans, dwarves, night elves, draenei, undead, trolls and blood elves can be priests.

title: Shaman Class
content: Shamans run on mana, wear mail from level 40, and drop totems that buff the group; Bloodlust, called Heroism for the Alliance, speeds up the whole party. Elemental casts, Enhancement fights in melee and Restoration heals, and Reincarnation lets them revive themselves. Only orcs, tauren, trolls and draenei can be shamans.

title: Mage Class
content: Mages wear cloth, like warlocks and priests, and run on mana: Arcane, Fire and Frost are their three damage trees. They polymorph enemies, conjure food and water, teleport themselves to capitals from level 20 and open portals for others from 40.

title: Warlock Class
content: Warlocks wear cloth, like mages and priests, and run on mana plus soul shards. Affliction, Demonology and Destruction are their three damage trees, and they summon demons such as the imp, voidwalker, succubus and felhunter. They make healthstones and soulstones and can summon party members with Ritual of Summoning, which needs two helpers to click the portal.

title: Druid Class
content: Druids shapeshift and wear leather: Balance casts in Moonkin Form, Feral fights as a cat or tanks as a bear, and Restoration heals, the only class that can tank, heal or deal damage in either melee or ranged. Rebirth revives an ally in combat and Innervate restores mana. Only night elves and tauren can be druids.

title: Death Knight Class
content: Death Knights are Wrath's plate-wearing hero class: they start at level 55 in Ebon Hold and need a level 55 character on the realm to create. They run on runes and runic power, and Blood, Frost and Unholy can each tank or deal damage. Death Grip pulls an enemy to them, and every race can be one.

title: Alliance Faction
content: The Alliance is one of the two major factions in Azeroth, consisting of noble and honorable races united against the Horde. Member races include Humans, Dwarves, Gnomes, Night Elves, and Draenei. The Alliance values honor, tradition, and protecting Azeroth from threats. Their capital cities include Stormwind, Ironforge, Darnassus, and the Exodar. Alliance players work together to maintain peace and order.

title: Horde Faction
content: The Horde is a powerful faction of warrior races who fight for survival and strength. Member races include Orcs, Trolls, Tauren, Undead (Forsaken), and Blood Elves. The Horde values strength, honor in battle, and protecting their way of life. Their capital cities include Orgrimmar, Thunder Bluff, Undercity, and Silvermoon City. Horde players are fierce warriors who respect strength and combat prowess.

title: Human Race
content: Humans are the most widespread and adaptable race in Azeroth, known for their resilience and determination. They founded the Alliance and built the mighty kingdom of Stormwind. Humans excel at all classes and are known for their diplomacy and leadership. Key traits include the Human Spirit (+3% Spirit) and Diplomacy (+10% reputation gains with every faction). Humans start in Elwynn Forest and have access to mounts at level 20.

title: Orc Race
content: Orcs are fierce and honorable warriors from Draenor, brought to Azeroth through the Dark Portal. They form the backbone of the Horde and value strength and combat prowess above all. Orcs have Command (+5% pet damage), Axe Specialization, Hardiness (reduced stun duration), and the activated Blood Fury racial. They start in Durotar and have a rich history of shamanism and warfare. Notable orcs include Thrall, Garrosh Hellscream, and Grommash Hellscream.

title: Dwarf Race
content: Dwarves are stout, bearded mountain dwellers known for their craftsmanship and love of ale. They are master miners, blacksmiths, and engineers. Dwarves have Gun Specialization, Mace Specialization, passive Frost Resistance, and the activated Stoneform racial, which cures poison, disease, and bleed effects. They start in Dun Morogh and are fiercely loyal to the Alliance. Dwarves excel at warrior, priest, and hunter classes. Famous dwarves include King Magni Bronzebeard and Muradin Bronzebeard.

title: Night Elf Race
content: Night Elves are ancient, immortal beings who protect the natural world of Azeroth. They are master druids, hunters, and warriors with a deep connection to nature. Night Elves have Quickness (melee and ranged attackers are 2% less likely to hit them), Nature Resistance (2% less likely to be hit by Nature spells), and Shadowmeld, an activated near-invisibility used while standing still; on death they briefly become a fast-moving wisp. They start on the sacred tree of Teldrassil and are devoted to Elune. Night Elves excel at druid, hunter, and priest classes. Key figures include Tyrande Whisperwind and Malfurion Stormrage.

title: Tauren Race
content: Tauren are massive, peaceful nomads from the plains of Mulgore, devoted to the spirits of nature. They are natural shamans and druids with a deep spiritual connection to the elements. Tauren have Endurance (+5% base health), War Stomp (an activated stun on nearby enemies), Cultivation (+15 Herbalism skill), and Nature Resistance (2% less likely to be hit by Nature spells). They start in Mulgore and have a rich culture of storytelling and herbalism. Tauren excel at druid, shaman, and warrior classes. Cairne Bloodhoof is the tauren high chieftain, ruling from Thunder Bluff.

title: Troll Race
content: Trolls are fierce jungle warriors from the islands of the South Seas, known for their regeneration and voodoo magic. They are agile hunters and warriors with a tribal culture. Trolls have Berserking (an activated 20% attack and casting speed burst, a flat amount since the Wrath revamp), Regeneration (faster health regen that partly continues in combat), and Beast Slaying (+5% damage to Beasts). They start in Durotar alongside the orcs. Trolls excel at hunter, mage, priest, rogue, shaman, and warrior classes. Notable trolls include Vol'jin and Zul'jin.

title: Gnome Race
content: Gnomes are ingenious tinkerers and inventors from the underground city of Gnomeregan. They are brilliant engineers and mages with a love for technology. Gnomes have Expansive Mind (+5% intellect), a 2% reduced chance to be hit by arcane spells (Arcane Resistance), and Engineering Specialization (+15 engineering skill). They start in Dun Morogh and are loyal Alliance members. Gnomes excel at mage, rogue, and warrior classes. Famous gnomes include High Tinker Mekkatorque and Sicco Thermaplugg.

title: Forsaken (Undead) Race
content: The Forsaken are undead beings who broke free from the Scourge, fighting for their freedom. They are cunning rogues and warlocks with resistance to fear and sleep. Forsaken have Will of the Forsaken (removes fear, sleep, and charm effects), Cannibalize (health regen from nearby corpses), and passive Shadow Resistance. They start in Tirisfal Glades and rule the Undercity. Forsaken excel at rogue, warlock, priest, mage, and warrior classes. Queen Sylvanas Windrunner leads the Forsaken.

title: Blood Elf Race
content: Blood Elves are magically addicted survivors of the fallen kingdom of Quel'Thalas. They are powerful mages and paladins with a thirst for magic. Blood Elves have Arcane Torrent (a silence that also restores mana, energy, runic power, or rage), Arcane Affinity (+10 Enchanting skill), and passive Magic Resistance. They start in Eversong Woods and are ruled from Silvermoon by Regent Lord Lor'themar Theron; Kael'thas Sunstrider betrayed them and is now an enemy. Blood Elves excel at mage, paladin, priest, rogue, hunter, and warlock classes.

title: Draenei Race
content: Draenei are a tailed, hooved alien race who crashed on Azeroth fleeing demonic pursuers. They are holy paladins and priests with a devotion to the Light. Draenei have Heroic Presence (+1% hit chance for themselves and their party), Gift of the Naaru (an activated heal-over-time), and Gemcutting (+5 Jewelcrafting skill). They start on Azuremyst Isle and have advanced technology. Draenei excel at paladin, priest, shaman, mage, hunter, and warrior classes. Prophet Velen leads the draenei.
